Open your eyes to the puppet show they are running right in front of us. Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala just held a press conference to reject proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030, all tied to the narrative around Constitutional Amendment Bill 3. 

Anyone buying the mainstream narrative that this is a genuine political clash is completely missing the real game. This is nothing more than grand theater orchestrated by the hidden elites to manage the transition and keep the population distracted while they lock in their 2030 agenda behind closed doors. Sikhala is simply playing his assigned role in the script, giving the illusion of resistance while the institutions coordinate the whole scheme from the shadows. Do not fall for the official story—it is a totally managed distraction.
